decision_conditions: The&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 107%;">proposal is NOT therefore a lawful development.</span>

<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed cubic content of the resulting roof space would exceed the cubic content of the original roof space by more than 50 cubic metres and is therefore not within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class B.1 (d) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The existing loft conversion by reason of the rear dormer not being fully within the rear roofslope, has not demonstrated that the materials used in the facing flank elevation of the rear dormer, when viewed from ground level, would appear to be of similar colour and design to the materials used in the main roof of the subject dwellinghouse. The existing development would not therefore be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class B, Condition B.2 (a) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The eaves of the original roof have not been&nbsp;maintained or reinstated and is therefore not within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class B.2 (b) (i) (aa) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span></p>

<span style="line-height: 107%;">The edge of the enlargement closest to the eaves of the original roof is less than 0.2 metres from the eaves, measured along the roof slope from the outside edge of the eaves, and is, therefore, not within tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class B.2 (b) (i) (bb) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span>

<p>The&nbsp;<span style="line-height:normal">enlarged part of the dwellinghouse would be within 2 metres of the boundary of the curtilage of the dwellinghouse, and the height of the eaves of the enlarged part would exceed 3 metres, and is, therefore, not within tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class A.1 (i) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span><br><br></p>

<p>It has not been demonstrated that&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 107%;">the rooflights would not protrude more than 0.15 metres beyond the plane of the slope of the original roof when measured from the perpendicular with the external surface of the original roof and is, therefore, not within the tolerances of&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: normal;">Schedule 2, Part 1 Class C.1 (b) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span></p>
description: Certificate of Lawful Development (Proposed): Single storey side extension; alterations and extension to roof to form end gable; rear dormer; three rooflights in front roof slope (Demolition of garage)
